cases.name: Candace Elizabeth Katherine Hawkins
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She loved her family and friends fiercely and had a passion and pursuit for so many things she enjoyed in life; cooking, gardening, skiing, baseball, golf, football ,astronomy, the beach, serving others and so much more.

We know she was welcomed home into God’s loving arms and in a glorious reunion. Candace’s light will shine forever."
cases.narrative: A hunting knife was found which may have been the murder weapon, and a gas can was recovered.
